#### **Why join us?**

  

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

  

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

#### **Bombardier’s Benefits Program**

  

With our employees’ well\-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

* Insurance plans *(Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)*
* Competitive base salary
* Retirement savings plan
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tele Health Program

### **What are your contributions to the team?**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support secure applications and APIs from proof of concept through production.
* Develop responsive, accessible user interfaces and reliable back\-end services.
* Integrate solutions with incumbent enterprise systems and approved platforms, including Azure, Databricks, SAP S/4HANA, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power BI, and related APIs or services.
* Productize forecasting, optimization, NLP, RAG, and classification models through reliable interfaces and workflows.
* Implement identity, authorization, secrets management, encryption, input validation, audit logging, backup, and recovery controls.
* Establish automated delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, testing, vulnerability scanning, and release\-management practices.
* Implement application and infrastructure monitoring, incident response, performance tuning, and maintenance plans.
* Partner with cross\-functional business, technology, data, governance, and delivery stakeholders across the enterprise.
* Translate business requirements into maintainable technical designs and acceptance criteria.
* Capture usage and user feedback to improve product adoption, accessibility, and performance.
* Maintain architecture, operational, security, and support documentation.
### **How to thrive in this role?**

* You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* You have 3\+ years of experience in cloud\-native software development.
* You are proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript and Python.
* You possess programming experience with React or an equivalent modern front\-end framework.
* You are hands\-on in Azure development using App Service, Azure Functions, containers, storage, queues, identity, and monitoring,
* You possess experience integrating applications with Databricks, including SQL, notebooks or jobs, model\-serving endpoints, Lakehouse patterns, and Unity Catalog concepts.

* You possess strong collaboration and communication skills.
* You are fluent in English and French (spoken and written), with the ability to work effectively in a bilingual environment.
**Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!**

  

Please note: You don’t need *all* the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 388633
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a technicien support informatique / Desktop Support Technician to join our team in Dorval, Quebec (CA\-QC), Canada (CA).
  
  

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un technicien support informatique pour notre équipe à Montréal, au Québec.
  
  

L’analyste technique des services sur place assurera le soutien et l’entretien dans l’environnement informatique de bureau de l’organisation. Ces tâches comprennent l’installation, le diagnostic et l’entretien de tout l’équipement de bureau, des imprimantes, des applications logicielles et des appareils mobiles afin d’assurer un rendement optimal. Le soutien sera offert en personne (utilisateurs sur place) ou par téléphone ou à distance (utilisateurs hors site).
  
  

Responsabilités
  
– Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien des applications et de l’équipement technologiques en repérant, en recherchant et en réglant les problèmes techniques.
  
– Apporter de l’aide sur place pour résoudre les problèmes technologiques et assurer le transfert de connaissances aux utilisateurs finaux sur une variété de questions liées à l’informatique.
  
– Effectuer les déménagements, les installations et les annulations prévus, ainsi que d’autres tâches liées au MAC.
  
– Fournir un soutien de niveau II de qualité aux utilisateurs ayant un degré élevé de satisfaction de la clientèle, des connaissances techniques et une rapidité d’exécution, soit en réglant le problème, soit en transmettant et en coordonnant les efforts d’autres membres du personnel des technologies de l’information.
  
– Résoudre les problèmes techniques et/ou enquêter sur les problèmes importants en confirmant la validité du problème et en recherchant des solutions connues aux problèmes ou enjeux plus complexes. Le candidat ou la candidate doit savoir à quel moment transmettre à la direction les problèmes non réglés à ce niveau.
  
– Utiliser la plateforme ServiceNow pour le suivi des problèmes, en veillant à ce que toutes les demandes d’aide des utilisateurs soient accompagnées d’un billet et que tous les incidents nécessitant un suivi ou des appels reçoivent l’attention appropriée.
  
– S’assurer que tous les incidents sont réglés dans le respect des niveaux de service documentés.
  
– Interagir avec les services de gestion des actifs, de réseau, d’ingénierie des systèmes logiciels, de mise au point d’applications et/ou d’entretien des imprimantes pour rétablir le service et/ou cerner et corriger le problème de base.
  
– Contribuer à l’élaboration et à la documentation des améliorations apportées aux processus actuels, à la création et à la mise à jour des capitaux de connaissances et des procédures normales d’exploitation.
  
– Posséder d’excellentes compétences en matière de présentation, de communication orale et de communication écrite.
  
– Apporter un soutien pour la mise à niveau technique, au besoin.
  
– Toutes les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées.
  
  

Compétences
  
  

– Plus de cinq ans d’expérience du soutien aux utilisateurs finaux et du soutien bureautique.
  
  

– Plus de cinq ans d’expérience du système d’exploitation Windows, de l’installation locale et de réseau, d’Internet Explorer, du protocole TCP/IP, du protocole DHCP, du gestionnaire de dispositifs, de l’éditeur du registre, du gestionnaire des utilisateurs et des commandes administratives.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Desktop Support Technician to join our team.
  
  

The Field tech Analyst will provide support and maintenance within the organization's desktop computing environment. This includes installing, diagnosing, and maintaining all desktop equipment, printers, software applications and mobile devices to ensure optimal performance. Support will be performed in person (on\-site users) or via telephone/remote control (off\-site users).
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Ensure proper day\-to\-day operation of technology applications and equipment by identifying, researching and resolving technical problems.
* Provide deskside assistance to resolve technology issues and provide how\-to knowledge transfer to end users on a variety of computer\-related issues.
* Perform scheduled moves, installations, and cancellations, as well as other MAC\-related tasks.
* Provide quality level II support for users with a high degree of customer satisfaction, technical knowledge and timeliness either by resolving the issue or escalating and coordinating efforts of other Information Technology staff.
* Solve technical issues and/or investigate elevated issues by confirming the validity of the problem and seeking known solutions to more complex problems or issues. Must know when to escalate issues not resolved at this level to management.
* Utilize ServiceNow for issue tracking, ensuring all user requests for assistance are accompanied by a ticket and all tickets requiring follow\-up work and/or calls receive appropriate attention.
* Ensure all tickets are resolved within documented service levels.
* Interact with asset management, network services, software systems engineering, applications development and/or printer maintenance services to restore service and/or identify and correct core problem.
* Assist in developing and documenting improvements to current processes, creating/updating KAs and SOPs.
* Possess excellent presentation, verbal communication and written skills.
* Provide technology refresh support as needed.
* All other tasks as assigned.


Qualifications
  
  

* 5\+ years of experience with end user support desktop support.
* 5\+ years of experience with Windows operating system, local/network installation, Internet explorer, TCP/IP, DHCP, Device Manager, Registry editor, User Manager Admin Commands.

**About AlayaCare**
-------------------



At AlayaCare, we're more than just a fast\-growing SaaS company, we're a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud\-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients. With 600\+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we're united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.


**About the Role**
------------------



Reporting to the Associate Director of Professional Services, the Professional Services Consultant plays a critical, customer\-facing and internal role in enabling the growth of a best\-in\-class professional services organization. This role is responsible for the successful delivery and execution of professional services\-led implementations and projects. Leading both customer and internal stakeholders, you'll bring subject matter expertise in specific functional areas (AlayaCare Platform, Home Care industry) that drives value into project deliverables. You'll manage complex components of engagements, working closely with customers to understand pain points and achieve positive outcomes, and you'll own the quality of project delivery and the reporting of customer outcomes. This is an individual contributor role that gains seniority through ongoing specialization.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Lead teams through the Discovery phase, including project requirements gathering, workflow design, configuration, reports, testing, and user training
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, supporting customer issues as they arise and looping in the project manager when issues may impact project scope, timeline, or budget
* Partner with Account Managers to ensure a smooth transition for customers out of the stabilization stage of their customer journey
* Contribute to the development of repeatable professional services offerings and packages
* Deliver data\-driven consulting recommendations based on industry and segment best practices
* Execute on defined professional services engagements
* Identify new Professional Services opportunities with existing customers, engaging with Account Managers to define and pitch those opportunities
* Support Implementation Specialists in learning the product and market, and in delivering quality engagements
* Provide input into the development of new professional services offerings
* Provide ongoing coaching to Implementation Specialists on your projects, including documenting feedback useful to their manager
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of, and compliance with, internal processes and procedures
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned
* Travel will be required
* Occasional work on the weekend is required

**What You Bring to the Team**
------------------------------


* 4\+ years of experience in software or business process consulting and/or home health care
* 2\+ years of experience leading complex internal/external engagements, including functional and cross\-functional teams
* Exceptional written and verbal communications in both English and French
* A passion for understanding customers' business goals and challenges
* The ability to effectively communicate with customer leadership
* The ability to recognize and articulate complex problems related to a project
* Deep expertise in the AlayaCare platform and/or relevant functional areas
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including experience successfully delivering presentations and managing meetings
* The ability to handle various projects simultaneously, adapting quickly and easily while managing competing priorities
* A strong willingness to take initiative, work autonomously, and manage time effectively to meet pressing deadlines

**Location and Work Model**
---------------------------



This role is based in the Greater Montreal Area. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes set in\-office collaboration days, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.


**Why Join AlayaCare?**
-----------------------


**Work With Purpose** At AlayaCare, you'll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.


**Grow in a High\-Trust Culture** We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you'll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote\-from\-within philosophy.


**Balance That Works for You** We value flexibility and well\-being. From "Wellness Fridays" to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.


**Benefits That Matter**


* Equity in a well\-funded, scaling company.
* Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.
* Parental leave top\-up and family support programs.

**Inclusive by Design** We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee\-led events, summits, and social activities, both in\-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.


**Ready to Join Us?**
---------------------



Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
**About WCMRC**

  



Western Canada Marine Response Corporation is a Transport Canada\-certified marine response organization responsible for providing marine spill response services along British Columbia’s coast. Our work is operationally complex, time\-sensitive, and essential to protecting coastal communities, marine environments, and critical infrastructure.

  



We are seeking an experienced and capable IT Support Technician to support the administration, security, maintenance, and ongoing improvement of WCMRC's technology environment. This position requires sound technical judgment, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in both day\-to\-day operations and emergency response environments.

  


**The Opportunity**

  



This position provides technical support to WCMRC employees and assists with the operation and maintenance of the organization's technology systems. With directions from the Director, Information Technology, the successful candidate will gain hands\-on experience supporting Microsoft 365, infrastructure, networking, and end\-user technologies while developing their technical skills \& knowledge.

  


**What You’ll Do**


* Provide Tier 1\-2 level support to end users and oversee access to applications.
* Provide training to staff on usage of newly implemented systems.
* Respond to technical issues and assist with troubleshooting and resolution of hardware, software, and infrastructure problems.
* Assist with maintenance, monitoring, and support of infrastructure systems under the guidance of senior IT staff.
* Ensure project documentation is complete and archived appropriately following project completion.
* Collaborate with network services, software systems engineering and/or application development to restore service and/or identify problems.
* Assist with the administration and support of Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and related infrastructure systems.
* Foster positive communications within the organization, the department, and work teams from a technology standpoint.
* Participate in infrastructure projects (systems and networks).
* Identify and communicate ideas for improving software processes.
* Assist in other duties involving computer and network setup and operations.
* Primarily provide remote support but also provide on\-site support as required.

  


**Our Commitment as a Response Organization**

  



WCMRC is an emergency response organization. Candidates must understand that our work is urgent, operationally dynamic, and often unpredictable. During a response, exercise, incident, or other operational requirement, shifts, schedules, reporting relationships, priorities, and assigned duties may change to meet organizational needs and to align with the Incident Command System structure.

  



This role requires flexibility, resilience, sound judgment, and a clear commitment to operational readiness, safety, accountability, and effective emergency response.

  


**Required Skills and Experience**

  



We are looking for a technically capable IT Support Technician who can work independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate. The successful candidate will bring:

  


* Diploma, certificate, or equivalent education in Information Technology, Networking, Systems Administration, or a related field.
* Microsoft certification.
* 1\+ years of previous and progressive technical support, IT help desk, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience providing software application support including dealing with users, and working with computers, printers, and phones.
* Experience supporting Windows workstations, Microsoft 365, printers, mobile devices, or other business technology.
* Demonstrated interest in learning new technologies and developing technical skills.

  


**Why Join WCMRC**

  



We know that meaningful work is only part of the equation. That is why we offer a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package that includes:

  


* Competitive compensation with an incentive plan.
* 100% employer\-paid benefits for you and your family.
* Generous and flexible work arrangements, including options for compressed work weeks.
* Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP) to support your long\-term financial wellness.
* Ongoing training and development opportunities to support personal and career growth.
* The opportunity to work alongside dedicated professionals committed to protecting the West Coast environment.

  




Salary Range: $68,438 to $80,515 annually, based on experience and qualifications. A higher starting salary may be considered for applicants who bring additional relevant experience, advanced expertise, or exceptional qualifications aligned with the needs of the role.

  


**Ready to Apply?**

  



Bring your organizational expertise, initiative, and judgment to a role where you will make a meaningful impact every day. Apply today and help enable the leadership that protects our coast.

  



To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter. Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada.

  



We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to support your participation.

  



We appreciate all applications; however, only candidates selected to move forward in the recruitment process will be contacted.

jobs.title: Network Support Technician (On-Site) -Information Technologies
jobs.description:
**Description**


The **Information Technologies** is currently seeking a Full\-time Regular **Network Support Technician**.


The Network Services team provides reliable, secure, and scalable network connectivity to the University community. This is a hands\-on, front\-line technical position that reports to the Network Services Manager and works directly with faculty, staff, students, service teams, contractors, and other clients at campus locations.


The position works a seven\-hour day beginning at 7:00 a.m., Monday to Friday. Regular on\-campus attendance is an essential requirement because the work involves physical network equipment, telecommunications spaces, client locations, and in\-person troubleshooting. The position is not eligible for remote or work\-from\-home arrangements. Travel to remote sites is required, and occasional work outside regular hours may be necessary for planned changes, urgent incidents, or operational needs.


The work requires frequent movement between campus locations, competing priorities, timely client communication, and safe work around active network infrastructure. The incumbent may be required to lift and carry equipment, climb ladders, work in telecommunications rooms or other constrained spaces, and distinguish colour\-coded cabling.


The incumbent independently handles routine access\-layer incidents, approved port activations, equipment replacement, physical checks, validation, client communication, and documentation. Changes with broader service impact, unclear ownership, elevated security risk, or implications for core routing, firewall policy, network architecture, or NAC policy design must be escalated and approved through the appropriate operational or change\-management process.

**Summary of Key Responsibilities** (job functions include but are not limited to):


Front\-Line Client and Incident Support


* Receive, assess, prioritize, and resolve wired and wireless network incidents and service requests.
* Continuously and proactively monitor the ServiceNow queue throughout the workday, including before and after field assignments and at appropriate intervals while working away from the office. Promptly identify, acknowledge, prioritize, update, and advance assigned incidents and service requests. Active queue management is a critical responsibility and a key measure of success in this role.
* Work directly with clients to understand symptoms, explain findings in clear language, set realistic expectations, and confirm service restoration.
* Troubleshoot connectivity across the client device, wall outlet, cabling, switch port, wireless access point, VLAN, DHCP/DNS services, authentication, and NAC policy path.
* Use available monitoring, management, ticketing, and diagnostic tools to isolate faults and collect evidence.
* Escalate complex, high\-impact, security\-related, or out\-of\-scope issues with complete troubleshooting notes and relevant logs.
* Coordinate with the service desk, Network Services analysts, identity and security teams, vendors, contractors, and other technical groups until ownership and next actions are clear.
* Work effectively and safely alone at client and technical locations. Access\-Layer Installation and Operations

* Assist with network refreshes, moves, additions, changes, equipment inventories, site surveys, and coordinated maintenance activities.
* Work safely in active telecommunications spaces and protect service continuity, equipment, cabling, and client areas.


Network Access Control and Technical Troubleshooting

* Use Aruba ClearPass to investigate authentication, authorization, endpoint profiling, posture assessment, role assignment, and device\-onboarding issues within assigned access.
* Interpret common 802\.1X, MAC authentication, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, spanning\-tree, link, and PoE symptoms to determine the likely fault domain.
* Validate whether a problem is local to a client, port, cable, access switch, access point, building, or shared service before resolving or escalating it.
* Follow security, privacy, change\-management, and privileged\-access requirements. Do not alter firewall policy, core\-routing architecture, or restricted security controls unless specifically authorized and assigned.

Just simple, straightforward customer\-centered approach based on trust, honesty and integrity. Our clients consider us a Friend, Confidant, and Trusted advisor and rely on us for clear, unbiased expert technical advice.

We are looking for an experienced Tier II Service Technician to join our talented and supportive team. The successful candidate is a key contributor in the success of managing our client’s networks. This is achieved by quickly resolving incidents that our clients open tickets for and by constantly monitoring the alerts generated by our tools to resolve incidents before our clients are aware.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Success in the Tier II Technician position will be based on your ability to meet or exceed our client’s expectations and by exceeding the SLA (Service Level Agreements) put in place for the various agreements.

The position is full\-time Monday\-Friday from 8:00am\-5:00pm.

**Candidates must possess a valid driver’s license with access to a vehicle suitable for use to travel to and from client sites.**

**In addition to a competitive salary and benefits, we also offer:**

* A great office environment and fun team atmosphere. Our office is business casual, open\-concept and highly collaborative
* Opportunities for future growth within the company
* Training and development

**The core requirements for this position are:**

* Respond to incoming IT support requests via phone, email, chat, and though the ticketing system
* Troubleshoot and resolve network, hardware, software, and peripheral issues
* Document incidents and solutions clearly and accurately
* Provide on\-site support to clients in Edmonton, AB and assist with remote assistance as needed
* Reinforce SLA expectations and manage user relationships with professionalism
* Apply existing documentation and standard procedures to prevent recurring issues
* Support equipment setups, moves, and replacements
* Perform maintenance on workstations, printers, and peripherals
* Strong interpersonal skills which include a calm and welcoming manner, active listening and customer care is a must
* Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle

**Technical expertise required:**

* 4\+ years experience configuring, supporting \& maintaining:
* Microsoft Windows Server components
* Microsoft Azure environments
* Microsoft365 environments
* Solid practical technical knowledge of network and PC operating systems, current network protocols, and standards.
* Hands\-on experience in hardware troubleshooting and extensive application support experience.
* Understanding of advanced networking principles
* Understanding of advanced Cyber Security principles
* Certifications in CompTIA A\+, and ITIL are a strong asset
* Experience with Active Directory, Windows operating systems, Intune, MDM, RMM, endpoint management tools, and common security technologies.

**Educational or previous experience recommendations:**

* Post\-Secondary in Computer Science, Information Technology, networking and/or Cyber Security
* A\+ Certification is preferred Knowledge in basic networking configurations
* NET\+ Certification is preferred Experience in Windows Operating Systems
* Microsoft Certifications MS\-900 \& AZ\-900

**Additional Responsibilities:**

* Participate in the on\-call rotation, providing SureFire’s clients with responsive support with critical technology infrastructure incidents.

jobs.title: Network Field Technician
jobs.description:
Network Field Technician

**Viverlink Networks Inc. \| British Columbia**  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Setting:** On\-site / Field\-based  
**Location:** Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.  
**Travel:** Regular travel between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.; occasional travel to other areas of Ontario may be required.

About Viverlink Networks

Viverlink Networks Inc. is a growing Managed Field Services Provider (MFSP) supporting MSPs, technology companies, enterprise IT teams, and multi\-location organizations.

We provide reliable onsite IT and infrastructure execution, acting as the field\-service execution layer between remote IT operations and physical customer locations.

Our services include:

* On\-site IT and technical support
* Network and connectivity installations
* Infrastructure deployments and technology rollouts
* Hardware and workstation deployments
* Structured cabling and physical network infrastructure
* Security and compliance\-related installations

Our work is performed using defined work orders, professional field procedures, structured documentation, and clear communication with remote IT teams and project managers.

As Viverlink expands its regional presence in the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC., we are building a professional field\-service network and are looking for technicians who can grow with the organization and take on increasingly complex assignments.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Network Field Technician** who is comfortable working independently at customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC. and can represent Viverlink professionally in the field.

This is a hands\-on role involving network equipment installation, troubleshooting, structured cabling, hardware deployment, and onsite technical support.

You will frequently work from detailed work orders and coordinate with remote engineers, MSP teams, project managers, and customer representatives.

The right candidate does not need to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, good troubleshooting instincts, professional communication, and the ability to learn and grow.

Key ResponsibilitiesNetwork \& Infrastructure

* Install, replace, configure, and test network equipment such as switches, routers, wireless access points, and related hardware.
* Perform basic network connectivity troubleshooting using TCP/IP concepts and common diagnostic methods.
* Identify and troubleshoot physical network and infrastructure issues.
* Perform structured cabling activities, including cable routing, termination, labeling, patching, and basic testing.
* Install and organize network equipment in racks, cabinets, and customer environments.
* Assist with network upgrades, technology rollouts, hardware refreshes, and multi\-site deployments.
* Perform hardware replacement and equipment installation according to approved work instructions.

Field Service Execution

* Review work orders and site requirements before arriving onsite.
* Arrive prepared with the required tools, information, and equipment.
* Follow client\-specific instructions, technical documentation, site procedures, and safety requirements.
* Work independently while maintaining communication with remote technical teams.
* Escalate issues when they exceed the assigned scope or technical authority.
* Avoid making unauthorized changes to customer environments.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate work\-order and ticket information.
* Document work performed, findings, configuration changes, serial numbers, and relevant observations.
* Capture required photographs and other completion evidence.
* Clearly communicate issues, blockers, and outstanding work.
* Complete professional field\-service reports following Viverlink and client requirements.

Customer Interaction

* Represent Viverlink professionally at customer locations.
* Communicate clearly with site contacts and customer personnel.
* Manage expectations and provide accurate status updates.
* Maintain a professional presence in offices, retail locations, technical facilities, and other customer environments.
* Protect customer information and follow applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

Required Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate practical ability in several of the following areas:

Networking

* Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking.
* Familiarity with switches, routers, wireless access points, and network cabling.
* Ability to perform basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand IP addressing, Ethernet, VLAN concepts, and common network terminology.

Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure

* Experience with structured cabling.
* Ability to terminate, label, organize, and test network cables.
* Familiarity with patch panels, racks, cable management, and physical network infrastructure.
* Ability to use basic field testing and hand tools.

Troubleshooting

* Ability to systematically identify the cause of technical problems.
* Comfortable troubleshooting connectivity, hardware, cabling, and physical infrastructure issues.
* Able to distinguish between issues that can be resolved onsite and those requiring escalation.

Field Service

* Comfortable working independently at customer sites.
* Able to follow work orders and technical instructions accurately.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Reliable and punctual.
* Comfortable travelling between customer locations throughout the Metro Vancouver / Vancouver Island / Northern BC.

Communication

* Professional verbal and written communication.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical personnel.
* Able to provide concise and accurate field updates.

Assets / Preferred Qualifications

The following are considered assets but are **not mandatory**:

* CompTIA Network\+

jobs.title: Junior IT Infrastructure Technician
jobs.description:
**About Sync**  

Sync is a Canadian company building zero\-knowledge, end\-to\-end encrypted cloud storage and collaboration for over two million people and businesses worldwide. Unlike most of our competitors, we own and operate our own storage infrastructure rather than renting it. Our customers’ data lives on our hardware, in our racks, in Canada. That is a core part of our product promise, and it means the physical infrastructure is not a back\-office concern here. It is the product.  

  

**About the role**  

We are hiring a Junior IT Infrastructure Technician to help maintain the JBODs, servers, and network gear in our Toronto colocation facility. This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, with regular travel to our Toronto Data Centre required to do hands\-on work, and a genuinely strong entry point into storage and infrastructure engineering, you will be working directly on petabyte\-scale storage systems from your first week.  

  

You will rack and maintain hardware, replace failed drives and components, own the RMA process end to end, manage procurement, and support the day\-to\-day IT needs of the team. We are looking for someone early in their career who is curious about how things work and who moves toward problems instead of waiting to be assigned them. You will not be expected to arrive knowing everything. You will be expected to ask good questions, document what you learn, and take real ownership of the things you touch. Once you're ramped up, this role will also include participation in an on\-call rotation.  

  

**What you will do*** Maintain our JBOD storage enclosures: identify and replace failed drives, verify rebuilds complete cleanly, and track drive health and failure trends over time.
* Install, cable, configure, provision and decommission servers and storage chassis in our Toronto colocation cage.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware faults across drives, memory, PSUs, HBAs, SAS expanders, backplanes, and network components.
* Support network infrastructure: rack and cable switches, maintain accurate port maps, and assist with configuration changes under supervision.
* Support the team during critical situations: respond to monitoring alerts, work the relevant runbook, and help recover systems from unexpected failures.
* Own the RMA process end to end: identify the failure, open the case with the vendor, track the shipment, install the replacement, and confirm the fix. Then make sure the inventory reflects reality.
* Manage procurement for hardware and IT equipment, including quoting, purchase orders, receiving, and day\-to\-day vendor communication.
* Maintain an accurate asset inventory covering serial numbers, warranty status, rack and slot locations, and lifecycle state.
* Keep the cage clean and auditable through disciplined structured cabling, labelling, and cable management.
* Handle media sanitization and secure disposal of decommissioned drives in line with our security policies.
* Coordinate with the colocation provider on remote hands, access approvals, power and cooling questions, and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Provide general IT support to internal staff, including laptop provisioning, account setup, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Write and improve runbooks so the next person can do the task without having to ask.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents after an onboarding period.

**What we are looking for*** 0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, datacenter operations, or a related hands\-on technical role. Co\-op terms, internships, home labs, and personal projects all count.
* A proactive mindset. You notice the drive that keeps throwing errors before it fails outright, and you raise it.
* Real curiosity about infrastructure. You want to understand why a system behaves the way it does, not just which button restarts it.
* Working knowledge of server and storage hardware, and comfort using hand tools in a rack environment.
* Linux fundamentals at the command line: navigating the filesystem, reading logs with journalctl and dmesg, and using basic disk and filesystem tooling such as lsblk, smartctl and df.
* Basic networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLANs, switching, subnetting, routing and the ability to read and maintain a cable map.
* Care and precision around data. In a live storage environment, pulling the wrong drive matters — we need someone who checks twice before executing any task.
* Clear written communication. A significant part of this job is leaving a good record for the next person.
* Strong organizational habits, particularly around tracking assets, tickets, and open vendor cases.
* Ability to work on\-site in Toronto and to lift and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Eligibility to work in Canada.

**Nice to have*** Exposure to a colocation or datacenter environment.
* Familiarity with SAS or SATA storage topologies, RAID or erasure coding concepts, or distributed storage systems such as ZFS or Ceph.
* Scripting in Bash or Python to automate repetitive work such as drive health checks or inventory reconciliation.
* Experience with out\-of\-band management tools such as iDRAC, iLO, or IPMI.
* Any exposure to a switch CLI – Cisco NX\-OS or IOS, HP ProCurve, or similar –even if only show commands.
* Any exposure to monitoring and alerting tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix.
* Familiarity with Containers (Docker, LXC) or with a directory and identity service for user and device management.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Server\+, or equivalent coursework.

**Perks:*** Compensation range: $50,000 to $58,000 CAD
* Generous WSA program
* Best\-in\-the\-class health benefits
* Paid vacation with carry\-over
* Flexible Hybrid
* Direct hands\-on experience with petabyte\-scale storage infrastructure that very few companies our size operate themselves.
* A clear growth path toward storage, systems, or network engineering, with mentorship from the senior staff who built this infrastruct

**Light the Way with VIRL**

At Vancouver Island Regional Library (VIRL), we believe libraries strengthen communities by supporting learning, connection, and belonging. Every day, our staff help people access information, build skills, and discover new opportunities. Together, we are proud to *Light the Way* for the communities we serve.

We are seeking someone who is enthusiastic and dependable to join our team as a **Service Desk Analyst** on the **Information Technology** team located at the **Nanaimo North** branch. This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain meaningful work experience while contributing to a welcoming and inclusive library environment that serves communities across Vancouver Island, Haida Gwaii, and Bella Coola.

**What you’ll do**

Under the direction and support of the IT Operations Manager, the Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact for employees experiencing technical issues with Vancouver Island Regional Library (VIRL) owned technology, hardware and software and IT services. This includes VIRL’s public computing services. The Service Desk Analyst is responsible for providing Service Desk Support and resolving problems to the end user’s satisfaction concerning software, hardware, mobile devices, and network connectivity.

The Service Desk Analyst contributes to the effective operation of the IT Division through support, maintenance, and provisioning (with Manager approval) of the networked hardware and software, including PCs, Laptops, Tablets, Phones, computer applications and other related peripheral equipment.

* Provide excellent customer service to staff throughout VIRL by telephone, email, virtual client web portal or face\-to\-face interaction.
* Provide clients with timely and systematic solutions to their problem or request.
* Identify and prioritize problems based on impact to normal operations and on VIRL’s customers, appropriately managing customer expectations.
* Manage system incident workflow from identification to closure including communication to end client until the issue is resolved.
* Resolve various service requests including:
* New computing device setup including the unpacking of new or re\-purposed computers, monitors, and related desktop hardware, which may include traditional PCs, portable notebooks, mobile devices and public facing desktops.
* Install additional software and hardware (e.g. printers, scanners, network cards, etc.).
* Utilize system tools for proper imaging and deployment of devices as appropriate (Imaging, Mobile Device Management etc.)
* Maintain user access administration for appropriate services. (e.g. Internet, e\-mail, WAN/LAN/WLAN, FTP access)
* Upgrade or replace existing computer hardware and components. (e.g. hard drive, RAM, monitor, printer, and motherboard)
* Install and/or upgrade end user computer software and operating systems.
* Address end user computing hardware/software deficiencies directly with vendors and identify where warranties are valid. (licenses, certificates etc.)
* Provide system/security access management by setting up and maintaining user and group accounts with various rights for access to applications, files and print services.

**What you bring**

* Completion of a Degree or Diploma in the Information Technology field or equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* Minimum 2 years’ of service desk experience.
* Completion of ITIL Foundation, A\+ or Microsoft Certified Professional certification.
* Working knowledge of Office 365 and Azure services.
* Working knowledge to efficiently build, maintain and support complex network, server, and storage environments (physical and virtual).
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests, projects and timeline commitments.
* Demonstrated integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality associated with proprietary organizational, employee and customer data.
* Knowledgeable in the use of tools for mass deployment and maintenance of computers and mobile technologies. (E.g. Group policies, mobile device management, etc.)
* Excellent customer service skills and interpersonal skills to listen and understand a non\-technical users challenge, frustration or request.
* Valid BC driver’s license; may be required to travel and use own vehicle.

Vancouver Island Regional Library acknowledges that it operates on the traditional territories of the 53 First Nations within its service area, who are members of the Coast Salish, Haida, Nuu\-chah\-nulth, Kwakwaka’wakw, and Nuxálk peoples. VIRL honours its relationships with these Nations and with all First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples who reside in the region.

VIRL is one of the largest regional library systems in Canada, serving both rapidly growing urban centres and some of the most rural and remote communities in the country. Working in partnership with 38 local governments across a 42,000 km² service area, VIRL is committed to supporting livability, affordability, accessibility, literacy, lifelong learning, and community connection throughout the region.

At VIRL, we are committed to building a collaborative, inclusive, and forward\-thinking organizational culture where employees are supported to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in the communities they serve.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual with excellent problem\-solving abilities, strong documentation and communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.

· **Cross\-Platform Hardware \& Peripheral Management:** Troubleshoot, configure, and maintain corporate equipment, including Windows and macOS desktop/laptop systems, label and laser printers, scanners, multi\-function devices, and standard IT peripheral hardware.

**Corrpro Canada is looking for a** **Junior IT Support Specialist**

**Join the Industry Leader in Corrosion Control – Corrpro Canada!**


Take your career to the next level with the most recognized name in corrosion protection. At the forefront of technology\-driven corrosion control solutions, we're shaping the future—and we want you to be a part of it.

**Corrpro Canada is a technology\-enabled Cathodic Protection services company** that provides construction, inspection, engineering, materials management and custom software and hardware to deliver innovative and data\-driven corrosion management solutions. We are seeking a **temporary full\-time** Junior IT Support Specialist at our Edmonton Office to provide frontline technical support to Corrpro Canada, Inc. employees across office, remote, and field environments. This temporary role assists with daily IT operations, end\-user support, device deployment, Microsoft 365 administration, and IT projects. Working under the direction of the IT Manager, the successful candidate will help ensure reliable and efficient technology services while gaining experience across various areas of information technology.


As a Junior IT Support Specialist at Corrpro Canada …

**WHAT YOU’RE RESPONSIBLE FOR:**

* Providing first\-level technical support for hardware, software, mobile devices, printers, and peripheral equipment.
* Responding to IT service requests and troubleshooting user issues in a timely and professional manner.
* Assisting employees with Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
* Supporting remote and field personnel with connectivity and device\-related issues.
* Escalating unresolved technical issues to senior IT Operations Analyst as required.
* Assisting with employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including account creation, device setup, and access changes.
* Configuring and deploying laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and related equipment.
* Supporting administration functions within Microsoft 365, including Teams, SharePoint, Exchange Online, and Entra ID.
* Supporting Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), password resets, and access management processes.
* Assisting with IT projects, technology rollouts, equipment refreshes, and system upgrades.
* Supporting data gathering, testing, and documentation activities for new technology initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Diploma, certificate, or currently pursuing post\-secondary education in Information Technology, Computer Systems Technology, or a related field.
* Up to 2 years of experience in an IT support, help desk, or technical support role.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, mobile devices, printers, and networking concepts.
* Strong troubleshooting, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

***Preferred***

* Exposure to Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Intune, and Entra ID.
* Familiarity with SharePoint, Teams, and Power Platform solutions.
* Experience supporting remote or hybrid users.
* Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA A\+, or related certifications.

**WHAT YOU STAND TO GAIN:**

* As a PEOPLE POWERED Cathodic Protection company you can rest assure you will have the opportunity to work with the best in the industry!
* Corrpro Canada is a company at the forefront of technology\-enabled corrosion protection!
* You can be part of a company that supports digital transformation initiatives that directly impact operational excellence!
* Resources to improve your health and wellbeing, including fitness club membership discounts across Canada!
* We care about work\-life balance and some roles are eligible for hybrid options!

At Corrpro Canada we believe that everyday is an opportunity to be better, we do what is right, and we solve problems to make the communities we serve safer and more sustainable.


Diversity and inclusion are important to us. Corrpro Canada is an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome diversity. We are committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, veteran status, Indigenous/Native American status, or disability. Applicants with disabilities can request accessible formats, communication supports, or other accessibility assistance by contacting hiring@corrprocanada.com


Corrpro Canada’s Edmonton Office respectfully acknowledges that we are located on Treaty 6 Territory and within the Métis homelands and Métis Nation of Alberta Region 4\. We acknowledge this land as the traditional territories of many First Nations such as the Nehiyaw (Cree), Denesuliné (Dene), Nakota Sioux (Stoney), Anishinaabe (Saulteaux) and Niitsitapi (Blackfoot).

* Hands\-on experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Experience supporting sales and purchase order processes within Business Central.
* Experience creating or maintaining reports using Business Central, Excel or Power BI.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory administration.
* Good general networking and printer\-support knowledge.
* Strong PC hardware and software troubleshooting skills.
* Experience using Freshdesk or a comparable helpdesk platform.

Benefits:

jobs.description:
Position Overview:
**Position Summary:**

  

We are currently seeking a knowledgeable and customer\-focused **Device Technology Technical Support Specialist** to provide technical support, implementation assistance, troubleshooting, and training for Fujifilm Canada's Office Toner Based Equipment solutions. In this role, you will work closely with Channel Partners, customers, vendors, and internal teams to support print management, document workflow, hardware, software, and related business process solutions. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer experiences through effective solution deployment, expert technical guidance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

 **Position Responsibilities:**

 **Solution Implementation and Support**

* Configure, implement, test, and support print, scan, fax, document management, print management, secure print, document capture, and workflow solutions.
* Support installations, upgrades, configurations, testing, post\-implementation activities, and on\-site technical support as required.

**Technical Troubleshooting and Case Management**

* Diagnose, resolve, document, and follow through on technical support cases involving hardware, software, connectivity, network, operating system, application, cloud service, and workflow issues.
* Escalate and coordinate complex issues with internal teams, Technical Specialists, manufacturers, and other subject matter resources as required.

**Customer, Channel Partner, and Internal Support**

* Provide timely, professional, customer\-focused technical assistance to Channel Partners, customers, and internal Fujifilm Canada teams.
* Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, implementation planning, and training activities as required.

**Training, Documentation, and Knowledge Sharing**

* Deliver product, solution, and troubleshooting training to Channel Partners, customers, and other audiences.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, configuration guides, troubleshooting procedures, and support standards.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing activities, special projects, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement, Compliance, and Administration**

* Identify recurring issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and recommend improvements to products, processes, documentation, standards, and support procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of support activity, project status, training, escalations, resolutions, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain current knowledge of relevant industry trends, technologies, cloud services, cybersecurity considerations, and support practices.
* Comply with customer policies, site\-access requirements, safety procedures, security protocols, escalation procedures, service standards, and other applicable workplace policies.

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Specialist II (HL7/DICOM/SQL) - Canada
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear\-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.


Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report.

 **Job Description**  

Intelerad is seeking a Technical Implementation Specialist II to lead the delivery of complex technical and workflow implementation services for our Radiology Healthcare IT solutions. Operating with increased autonomy, you will design integration workflows, configure and validate enterprise systems, and guide clients through complex go\-lives. You will collaborate cross\-functionally with Project Management, Applications, and Workflow teams, and will contribute to continuous improvement by sharing implementation insights across the organization.


InteleShare is Intelerad’s medical image exchange platform, used by healthcare organizations to securely share imaging studies and related clinical information across facilities, providers, and care networks. This role will be part of the Technical Services group for the InteleShare team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead HL7/DICOM integration design, configuration, and deployment for complex client environments, ensuring alignment with clinical goals and Intelerad best practices.
* Diagnose and resolve advanced technical and workflow issues across applications, integrations, and infrastructure, both remotely and on\-site.
* Partner with Project Management to drive system integration and functionality milestones, providing regular status updates to clients and third\-party vendors.
* Design and deliver structured training programs for end users and administrators, adapting delivery to meet diverse learning needs and clinical settings.
* Document and maintain implementation artifacts — including configurations, workflows, and architecture changes — and contribute findings to post\-implementation reviews that drive process improvement.
* Assist with TS requests which may include custom reports, queries, identifying bugs, complex DICOM/HL7 migrations or workflows.

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Medical Imaging Sciences, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in healthcare IT implementation, system integration, or a related technical role.
* Demonstrated proficiency with HL7/DICOM standards and experience configuring healthcare system integrations.
* Proficiency with Linux command\-line interface and experience with SQL databases (e.g., Sybase, PostgreSQL, MS SQL).
* Ability to travel as required to support on\-site client engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements**

* In\-depth understanding of radiology workflows, including modality, PACS, RIS, and clinical imaging processes.
* Experience working with AWS cloud infrastructure and services.
* Understanding of API architecture and working with data formats such as JSON.
* Experience mentoring junior implementation staff or delivering structured clinical training programs.
* Exposure to enterprise go\-live planning and change management in healthcare environments.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud technologies.
* PostgreSQL database and query development.
* Familiarity with Python notebook development, Visual Studio Code, GitHub, and AWS SageMaker.
* Knowledge of InteleShare and/or Image Exchange platforms.

**Travel Requirements**

* Up to 10% travel may be required, occasionally on short notice.


This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

 **Additional Information**  

The base pay for this position ranges from $75,000 100,000/yr CAD within any geographic market in Canada. Pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.


Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist – GPS, Telematics & IoT
jobs.description:
**Position summary**

The Technical Support Specialist will assist customers with device activation, platform configuration, troubleshooting and ongoing technical support. The successful candidate should be comfortable working with GPS trackers, dashcams, mobile applications, web\-based platforms, SIM cards and basic vehicle wiring.

This position combines remote technical support, customer onboarding, device testing and coordination with installation technicians and hardware suppliers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to customers by telephone, email, WhatsApp and support\-ticket system.
* Activate and configure GPS trackers, asset trackers, dashcams, ELD devices, SIM cards and IoT sensors.
* Create customer, vehicle, driver and device accounts on supported telematics platforms.
* Guide customers through mobile applications and web portals.
* Diagnose device connectivity, GPS signal, SIM, wiring, power and platform\-related issues.
* Review device data, alarms, reports, video events and communication logs to identify problems.
* Perform bench testing and quality checks before devices are delivered or installed.
* Configure tracking intervals, geofences, alerts, user permissions and reports.
* Support live\-streaming dashcams, video retrieval and memory\-card troubleshooting.
* Coordinate installations, removals, inspections and service calls with field technicians.
* Maintain accurate records of IMEI numbers, SIM numbers, vehicle details, warranty status and support history.
* Escalate firmware, protocol, server and hardware problems to manufacturers or platform providers.
* Follow up on open tickets until the customer confirms that the issue has been resolved.
* Prepare simple user guides, troubleshooting instructions and installation notes.
* Assist with product demonstrations, customer training and onboarding sessions.
* Monitor offline devices and proactively contact customers when necessary.
* Support warranty claims, device replacement and return\-merchandise processes.
* Collaborate with sales and operations teams during pilots and new deployments.
* Maintain a professional, patient and service\-oriented relationship with customers.

**Required qualifications**

* Diploma or degree in electronics, IT, telecommunications, automotive technology, computer networking or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* At least one year of experience in technical support, GPS tracking, telematics, IoT, automotive electronics or a related technical role.
* Good understanding of GPS/GNSS, cellular networks, SIM cards and web\-based software platforms.
* Basic knowledge of vehicle electrical systems, including power, ground, ignition/ACC and digital inputs.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems logically and document the actions taken.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Comfortable communicating with drivers, fleet managers, installers and technical teams.
* Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office, web applications and mobile apps.
* Ability to manage multiple support cases and prioritize urgent customer issues.
* Legally authorized to work in Canada.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with GPS fleet\-management or video\-telematics platforms.
* Experience with Geotab, Tracksolid Pro, Switchboard ELD, Teltonika, Jimi IoT or similar products.
* Knowledge of AI dashcams, ADAS, DMS, ELD, BLE sensors, fuel sensors or temperature\-monitoring systems.

jobs.description:
Build Access. Build Solutions. Build Your Career.
  
At Northern Mat \& Bridge, we deliver innovative access solutions that support infrastructure, energy, and industrial projects across Canada. Our success is built on the strength of our people, from the field to the office, working together with integrity, safety, and pride. When you join NMB, you’re joining a team that values hard work, accountability, and long term growth.
  
  

At Northern Mat \& Bridge, we value diversity, teamwork, and respect. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering a safe, inclusive, and professional work environment. All employment offers are subject to applicable pre\-employment requirements. NMB is a drug and alcohol\-free workplace.
  
  

Northern Mat \& Bridge is seeking a skilled and service\-oriented IT Support Technician to join our Information Technology team. Reporting to the IT Manager, this role provides hands\-on technical support across the organization and plays a key role in maintaining reliable technology systems for employees and operational locations. The successful candidate will support end users, servers, networks, Microsoft 365 services, mobile devices, and business technology systems while contributing to technology projects, infrastructure improvements, and cybersecurity initiatives.

End User \& Technical Support
  
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support to employees across the organization.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, connectivity, and mobile device issues.
* Support workstations, laptops, printers, peripherals, and meeting room technology.
* Respond to service requests and technical incidents in a timely and professional manner.
* Deliver excellent customer service while educating users on technology best practices.


Infrastructure \& Systems Support
  
* Support local servers, network infrastructure, wireless systems, and business technology platforms.
* Assist with system maintenance, upgrades, and technology deployments.
* Monitor technology systems and escalate infrastructure issues as required.
* Support business continuity through reliable operation of technology resources.
* Maintain system documentation and technical records.


Microsoft 365 \& Security Support
  
* Coordinate with corporate IT on Microsoft 365, cloud services, cybersecurity, and infrastructure initiatives.
* Support user account management, access controls, and technology standards.
* Promote security awareness and compliance with technology policies.
* Assist with the resolution, escalation, and documentation of security\-related incidents.
* Support the implementation of cybersecurity controls and best practices.


Projects, Equipment \& Asset Management
  
* Support technology projects, equipment refreshes, and site improvement initiatives.
* Assist with the deployment, setup, configuration, and maintenance of IT equipment.
* Maintain accurate technology inventory records and supporting documentation.
* Track asset lifecycle activities, including procurement, deployment, and replacement.
* Support onboarding and equipment setup for new employees.


Vendor \& Service Coordination
  
* Coordinate with local technology vendors and service providers.
* Support vendor\-led installations, maintenance, and service activities.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure service expectations are met.
* Ensure all work is completed in accordance with company technology and security requirements.
* Assist with telecommunications and third\-party technology service coordination.


Qualifications \& Experience
  
* Minimum three (3\) years of experience in IT support, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related role.
* Post\-secondary diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems, Network Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* An equivalent combination of relevant education, technical training, and workplace experience may be considered.
* Experience supporting Microsoft\-based business environments is considered an asset.
* Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, construction, or multi\-site environments is considered an asset.


Other Skills and Abilities
  
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Commitment to professionalism, confidentiality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work in both office and industrial environments.
* Willingness to provide occasional after\-hours support when required.


Licence, Certification \& Education
  
* Post\-secondary diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems, Network Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA, or similar industry certifications are considered assets.
* Familiarity with Azure, Jamf Pro, Active Directory, and network infrastructure is considered an asset.
* Valid driver's licence and the ability to travel occasionally between company locations may be considered an asset.

At KTI Utility Services Inc. (KUS), we foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and safety. As a leading utility service provider committed to delivering exceptional services across Canada, we value our people and provide a supportive, dynamic, and rewarding work environment. Join our growing team and help us drive operational success!

**Position Overview**

We are seeking self\-starting individuals to add to our field installation team! If you consider yourself to be an independent worker with a great attitude, then this job is for you. The position requires a strong work ethic, mechanical aptitude, and attention to detail. Your primary role will be to excavate and install water meters, record the required data on a handheld device, and restore the area around the excavation. * Minimum one year of hands\-on experience in construction, trades, landscaping, or heavy physical labor; Previous water meter, meter pit, or residential water service line experience is a strong asset
* Solid mechanical aptitude with demonstrated familiarity using various hand tools and power tools
* Physical capability and stamina to perform heavy manual labor, outdoor digging, and lifting in varying weather conditions
* Independent worker with a great attitude, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively with minimal supervision
* Professional communication and interpersonal skills for interacting politely and clearly with homeowners and the public
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and driver’s abstract
* All candidates must successfully complete a mandatory clean criminal background check

As part of our recruitment process, we utilize AI\-assisted tools to support candidate evaluation. Please be assured that all applicants are assessed fairly and equitably based strictly on their professional qualifications, relevant skills, and core competencies.*

* Commuter benefits
* Company car

* Do you have at least 1 year of hands\-on experience in construction, trades, landscaping, or heavy physical labor, with familiarity using hand and power tools? (Yes / No)

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**


Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI\-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest\-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

**Our culture:**

* We hire talented, self\-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
* We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get\-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.
* We're a remote\-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to \- work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport\-optional, work\-from\-anywhere\-on\-Earth kind of remote \- think flexible *within* your country, not borderless.

**Location:**

* Remote \- United States or Canada

**About the role**


We are looking for a Senior Data/ML Engineer to own the data and machine learning foundation that Sardine's compliance decisions run on. Every onboarding decision we make — a payment approved, an account blocked, a KYC case escalated — is the output of a pipeline someone built. This role owns those pipelines end to end: how data arrives, how it becomes a feature, how that feature becomes a model, and how that model stays correct in production.


This is a high\-impact, highly technical IC role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and ML engineering. We need someone at the senior level to set technical direction for the next order of magnitude: new feature generation, build specific models around KYC onboarding, in house entity matcher for the sanctions and more


You will write production code, make architectural calls that outlive your tenure, and raise the bar for how a small team ships fraud ML. You will work directly with data scientists, backend engineers, and the fraud analysts who use what you build.

**What you'll be doing**

* Own the data ingestion layer that brings device telemetry, transaction events, KYC/identity signals, and third\-party enrichment into the platform — designing streaming pipelines (Pub/Sub, Apache Beam on Dataflow, Flink) and batch pipelines (Python, Airflow on Cloud Composer, Spark on Dataproc) that are correct, observable, and cheap to extend.
* Build and evolve our feature platform, where the same Chronon feature definitions are computed by Flink for streaming and Spark for batch, with aggregation windows from one hour to 300 days, served to the rules engine and to models under a sub\-second budget.
* Establish feature correctness as an engineering discipline: streaming\-versus\-batch reconciliation, recomputation tests against the warehouse, train/serve parity checks, and drift monitoring that catches a broken feature before an analyst does.
* Productionize fraud and identity ML models — training pipelines on Vertex AI and Kubeflow, gradient\-boosted and tree\-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, scikit\-learn), hyperparameter search, SHAP\-based explanations, and score normalization — and build the automated retraining, champion/challenger promotion, and rollback machinery we don't yet have.
* Engineer KYC, AML, and identity risk signals: document verification and doc\-KYC outcomes, sanctions/PEP/adverse\-media screening results, email and phone risk, synthetic identity indicators, bank and account verification, and periodic customer due diligence — turning noisy, multi\-vendor, multi\-jurisdiction data into features a model can actually learn from.
* Integrate and harden new data sources, including 30\+ third\-party enrichment providers called in parallel on the request path, plus our cross\-client consortium network — owning failover behavior, timeout budgets, graceful degradation, caching, and cost.
* Own the warehouse and modeling layer in BigQuery — partitioning strategy, the staging\-to\-mart layer cake, training datasets, and the in\-flight migration off dbt onto scheduled SQL and Python pipelines.
* Design the entity resolution and graph data that link customers, devices, emails, phones, cards, bank accounts, and crypto addresses across clients, including large\-scale connected\-components work.
* Make the platform safe by construction: field\-level encryption for sensitive identifiers, regional data residency enforced in the pipeline definitions, PII handling and deletion paths, and feature\-level gating so a bad signal can be turned off without a deploy.
* Set technical direction and raise the team's ceiling — write the design docs, run the reviews, mentor engineers and data scientists, and decide what we build versus buy.

**What you'll need**

* 8\+ years building production data and ML systems, with real ownership of both the pipeline side and the model side. You have shipped models that made consequential automated decisions, not just dashboards.
* Deep Python and strong SQL. You are fluent in a distributed processing framework (Spark, Beam, or Flink) and comfortable reasoning about streaming semantics — windowing, watermarks, late data, exactly\-once versus at\-least\-once, and where correctness actually breaks.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data stack: GCP strongly preferred (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Bigtable, Composer, Vertex AI) or the AWS equivalents, plus Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/C
