new_jobs.title: Support Analyst - Red Lake ON
new_jobs.description:
**About FSET Inc**  
FSET Inc is an ISO 27001:2022 certified Managed Services Provider headquartered in Kenora, serving law enforcement, healthcare, municipal and First Nations clients across Canada since 1999\. Our work includes the patented ConnectedOfficer Program, cybersecurity services and cloud infrastructure, delivered by a team of more than 30 people, all based in Canada.  


**Position Overview**  
We are hiring a Support Analyst to live and work in Red Lake, Ontario. This is a permanent, full\-time, home\-based position. You work from home and go onsite to FSET clients in Red Lake and neighbouring communities, including Pikangikum First Nation, where we support a number of community organizations.  


You are often the only FSET person on site, which makes network troubleshooting central to the job. When a site loses connectivity, you work the fault from the cable to the carrier: confirm the link, check addressing, DNS and the gateway, test at the internet connection, and establish whether the problem sits on the client's network or with the provider. If it is the provider's, you open the carrier ticket, supply the evidence and see it through. You own the fault until it is resolved or handed on with a complete diagnosis.  


Given who our clients are, you will work to a high standard of security and documentation, and we train and support you to meet it.  


**Work Environment and Location Requirements**  
You work from a home office in Red Lake with a private workspace and a reliable internet connection. Road travel to clients around Red Lake is a regular part of the week. Pikangikum is reached by air year\-round, by winter road from January to March and by boat in the warmer months, and some visits include an overnight stay. A valid driver's licence and reliable transportation are essential.  


**Key Responsibilities**  


* Take client requests by phone, email, portal and onsite; triage, diagnose, and resolve or escalate within service levels
* Troubleshoot network faults end to end: cabling and switch ports, Wi\-Fi, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, VPN clients and the internet connection, and manage carrier tickets with test evidence through to resolution
* Administer Microsoft 365 for managed clients: user lifecycle, licensing, Exchange Online, Entra ID and Intune
* Deploy and support Windows devices with Autopilot and Intune, along with mobile devices, printers, VoIP handsets and network equipment
* Keep documentation current for every ticket, client and site you work on
* Follow FSET information security policies and procedures without exception

**Required Qualifications**  


* 2\+ years of IT support at an MSP or in a multi\-client environment, including hands\-on administration of Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune
* Hands\-on TCP/IP troubleshooting: you read ipconfig, ping, tracert and nslookup output with ease, understand DHCP, DNS, subnetting, NAT and VLANs, and can isolate a fault to the local network or the internet provider
* Live in or relocate to Red Lake, hold a valid full driver's licence, and travel regionally by road, air and water
* Fluent professional English, written and verbal, a clear criminal record check, and eligibility for the security screening our law enforcement clients require

**Preferred Qualifications (Assets)**  


* Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, or ITIL Foundation
* Experience supporting business VoIP or UCaaS
* Experience supporting government or other regulated sectors
* Experience working with First Nations communities and organizations
* RMM or PSA platform migration experience
* French

**Professional Attributes**  


* You explain technical problems in plain language to people who are not technical
* You work reliably on your own, with sound judgement about when to bring in help
* You are organized, punctual, and careful with detail and documentation
* You respect each community's protocols and ways of working
* You can kneel, bend and work in tight or restricted spaces

**Compensation and Benefits Package**  


* Health, dental, extended health and vision coverage
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program for mental health and wellness
* RRSP matching
* Paid vacation, personal days and sick leave
* Paid training, plus industry certification support and reimbursement

**Why Join FSET**  


* Great Place to Work Certified every year since 2022, most recently in April 2026, and ranked 22nd on the 2025 Best Workplaces in Canada list for organizations with fewer than 100 employees
* Work that matters to the communities you live and travel in
* A clear promotion path from Support Analyst to Senior Support Analyst
* Colleagues who back you up when you are the only one on site

**Applying to FSET**  
This posting is for an existing vacancy.  


We use an applicant tracking system that screens and scores applications automatically, including with artificial intelligence, based on your answers to the questions on the application form.  


Accommodation is available on request for applicants with disabilities at every stage of our recruitment and selection process.  


Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent  


Pay: $70,200\.00\-$75,400\.00 per year  


Benefits:  


* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Red Lake, ON

**Junior Full\-Stack Software Developer**

 **About Effortless Admin**  

  

Benefits administration is complicated, and when it goes wrong, real people miss coverage they're counting on. Effortless Admin builds the platform that keeps it running smoothly for employers across Canada. We're a small team that moves fast. The code you write ships to real clients, and you'll see the difference it makes.  

  

**The role**  

**Full\-time \- On\-site in Edmonton, AB**  

  

As a Junior Full\-Stack Developer, you'll build features across our platform using React on the front end and C\#/.NET on the back end. You'll work side by side with senior developers who will review your code, pair with you, and help you grow quickly.  

  

**Why you'll like working here**  

  

We're a small team, and that's a big part of what makes this role different. You'll work closely with senior developers every day, with real pairing, quick answers when you're stuck, and direct feedback on your code.  

Because we're small and move quickly, good ideas don't sit in a backlog for months. The features you build will ship to real clients, and you'll see the impact of your work early and often.  

  

**How we're working with AI**  

  

We're actively bringing AI into how we work, using it to help us write, review, and test code, and exploring where it can make our platform better for clients.  

We don't have it all figured out, and that's the point. We're learning and experimenting as a team, and we want developers who are curious about it and will help us find where it makes a real difference. You don't need to be an expert, just interested.  

  

**What you'll do**


* Build responsive, easy\-to\-use interfaces with React and modern JavaScript
* Develop and maintain C\#/.NET services that power our core platform
* Design and connect RESTful APIs between the front end and back end
* Work with SQL Server to store and manage application data
* Build reusable components and keep the app fast
* Write clean, well\-tested code and take part in code reviews
* Work with our UX designers to turn designs into intuitive experiences
* Experiment with AI tools that help us build better and faster

  


**Who we're looking for**  

You think critically about code, including your own. You ask whether something will be easy to maintain, not just whether it works today, and you can explain your reasoning. You're also open to changing your mind as you learn, because what counts as good code keeps evolving.  

You're adaptable. You're comfortable picking up new tools, switching between front\-end and back\-end work, and learning as you go. On a small team things change quickly, and that's part of the fun.  

You also care about the people using what you build. You notice when a screen is confusing or a workflow takes one click too many, and you want to fix it. Our users are HR teams and employees dealing with their benefits, and making that experience feel effortless matters to us.

 **What you'll bring**  

  

**Must have**


* 1–2 years of hands\-on development experience (co\-op and internship work counts)
* Solid experience with JavaScript and React
* Working knowledge of C\# and .NET
* A good grasp of object\-oriented programming
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
* Comfort with SQL and relational databases
* Experience with Git


**Nice to have**


* A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience with React libraries like Redux or React Query
* A good understanding of CSS
* Experience on an agile team, using tools like Asana or Jira
* Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools


**What we offer**


* Competitive pay and a strong benefits package (we are a benefits company, after all)
* Daily mentorship, pairing, and code reviews with senior developers
* A clear path to intermediate and senior roles
* A modern stack and room to try new tools, including AI
* A team that respects work\-life balance
* An on\-site gym and swimming pool in our building

  


**How to apply**  

  

Send us your resume and a short note about why this role interests you. If you have a GitHub profile or projects you're proud of, include the links. We'd love to see what you've built.

  

Effortless Admin is committed to building diverse teams and an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

To innovate industries, transform businesses, connect communities, and drive meaningful change, we must think bigger, reach broader, and act bolder. Through knowledge, curiosity, and collaboration, Compugen helps organizations delivering experience by design. This is what it means to be human\-centered and technology\-enabled.
  

  

Dreaming, designing, and delivering isn't just a mantra for us — it's a way of life. We believe that technology is the conduit, but our people – they are the connection that truly makes the magic happen!
  

### **Our Culture**


We are a human\-centered culture where we prioritize your well\-being and are invested in helping you reach your fullest potential. We're not only focused on achieving our goals — we're dedicated to helping you achieve yours.
  

  

If you're relentlessly curious, driven to make a difference, and collaborative at the core, then you belong with us.
  

### **Technical Writer**

* We are seeking an experienced **Technical Writer for a Remote 12 month Contract** that may convert to permanent to support IT projects by creating, maintaining, and improving clear, accurate, and user\-friendly technical and business documentation. The successful candidate will work closely with technical and business teams to translate complex information into documentation that is easy to understand and aligned with organizational standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain technical and business documentation for IT projects and initiatives.
* Translate complex technical and business information into clear, accurate, and accessible content.
* Work closely with Architects, Developers, Business Analysts, Quality Analysts, Product Owners, and leadership stakeholders to gather and validate information.
* Review existing documentation and identify gaps, inconsistencies, ambiguities, and areas for improvement.
* Ensure documentation meets quality, accessibility, compliance, and governance standards.
* Organize and maintain documentation within Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar repositories.
* Support documentation updates throughout the project lifecycle.
* Collaborate with project teams to ensure documentation reflects current processes, systems, requirements, and solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve documentation processes, standards, and templates.

* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer or in a similar documentation\-focused role.
* Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Technology, or a related field.
* Strong experience creating technical and business documentation for IT projects.
* Experience working with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar documentation repositories.
* Excellent written communication, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in Agile environments.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Scrum, or similar project management tools.
* Experience supporting cloud\-based platforms and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with enterprise IT teams and complex technical environments.

**Want to know the secret behind our company's success?**

At Sonovision, we are always exploring new ways to reach our goals. We explore areas outside of our comfort zone and push the boundaries to achieve our goals beyond what we think is possible. We believe it is essential to create an environment where everyone feels listened to, respected and supported. We encourage collaboration and empathy so that we can work together harmoniously and constructively. We hold ourselves to the highest standards and continuously exceed customers expectations.


Sonovision is a division of the Ortec Group. The Ortec Group is present in 25 countries, the Ortec Group deploys engineering and works solutions in many sectors: energy, mining, chemicals, defence, transport, agri\-food, aeronautics, space, environment, local authorities, etc. Its 14,500 employees ensure the design, construction and maintenance of industrial projects and facilities. This strategy is based on a foundation of "Made in Ortec" values, where safety, innovation and training are made a priority.




**Job Summary**


At Sonovision, we deliver high\-quality technical documentation supporting some of the most advanced aerospace and defense programs in the world. We are seeking a Technical Writer with strong expertise in XML/SGML\-based structured authoring, S1000D, and ATA iSpec 2200\. Your work will transform complex engineering information into clear, accurate, and compliant technical content used globally.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, revise, and maintain technical documentation in accordance with S1000D (Issue 4\.x/5\.x), ATA iSpec 2200, ATA 100, and AG\-006 standards.
* Author Data Modules (DMs) using XML/SGML in a structured authoring environment.
* Interpret engineering drawings, maintenance procedures, and technical designs to produce accurate, user\-focused documentation.
* Ensure compliance with BREX rules, project\-specific business rules, and customer requirements.
* Collaborate with engineers, technical data managers, and project leads to ensure high\-quality and timely deliverables.
* Maintain version control, track changes, and support configuration management activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of documentation processes and internal best practices.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience authoring XML/SGML\-based technical documentation.
* Hands\-on experience producing S1000D\-compliant content, including DMs, DMRLs, and BREX validation.
* Experience with structured authoring tools such as Arbortext Editor, oXygen XML Author, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of aerospace or mechanical/electrical technical domains.
* Excellent written communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Familiarity with ATA iSpec 2200 documentation requirements.
* Knowledge of ASD\-STE100 Simplified Technical English (STE).
* Experience with CSDB systems such as EAGLE Publishing System, R4i, Tridion Docs, or comparable platforms.
* Aerospace maintenance or engineering background.




**What we can offer you:**

* Remote work opportunities
* Flexible schedule, based around a core set of hours.
* Training and Development Programs.
* Casual and collaborative work environment.
* 3 Weeks paid vacation.
* Health, dental, and life insurance benefits.

*Sonovision is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment, selection, and employment process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process or during employment, please contact Human Resources so that appropriate arrangements can be made.*
